---
title: "Open Admin"
subtitle: "SOP MGR-02 · Manager manual"
---

## Purpose

Open Admin, the shop's to-do list for managers: paperwork waiting to be
verified, hand checks waiting for a second look, and changes to review.

## Applies to

Managers only. Admin does not open for a groomer's profile.

## Before you begin

- You are signed in to your own profile. See [MGR-01 Sign in to your
  profile](signing-in.qmd).
- You have a passkey (your fingerprint, face or phone) or an Admin PIN set up.

## Procedure

1. Click **Admin** at the top of the screen, next to **Check-in** and
   **Calendar**. The screen shows **🔒 Admin is locked** and
   **Prove it's you**, followed by your name.

   ![Admin, locked](/screenshots/manager/admin-door.png)

2. Open Admin in one of two ways:
   - **With a passkey:** click **Use my passkey**, then follow the prompt on
     your device. On a shop tablet, choose **use a phone** and scan the code
     with your own phone.
   - **With a PIN:** click the **Your PIN** box, type your PIN, then click
     **Open with PIN**.

   Admin opens.

## Result

A green bar at the top of Admin shows **🔓 Admin open for** your name, and the
time at which Admin locks again.

## When you are finished

Click **Lock Admin** in the green bar. If you do not, Admin locks by itself
after 30 minutes.

## If something goes wrong

### Set up how you open Admin

This is the first time this profile has opened Admin. Click **Set up a
passkey**, or type a PIN of 4 to 8 digits in **Set a PIN** and again in
**Again**, then click **Set PIN**. After this, only you can change them.

### The two PINs don't match.

The PIN typed in **Again** is different from the first one. Type both
again.
